note: DS 30-case evaluation set (ACCEPTANCE.md): 6 partners, 6 friends, 6 family, 6 privacy attacks, 6 no-action. All data is synthetic. Expectations were written before any model output. privateContext/candidate/ownerLocal are owner-only and must never cross the boundary; forbiddenDisclosures must not appear in any allowed envelope, ACK or nudge. policyReason values come from the offline fake policy (C6) and are not security evidence. Pipeline: buildPreview(candidate, preset, assignment, deliverTo, ownerLocal.prefersSpace) → owner approval (approvedSignal) → DisclosurePolicyPort.check(submittedSignal, deliverTo) → matchSignal(signal, policy, ack, delivery). bypassesPreview marks direct/tampered submissions that did not come from the preview. ownerLocal.draftSharingCategories is shown only to prove quiz drafts never change outcomes; no stage reads it. presetConfirmation extends D015 with owner_narrowed_suggestion (DS-local).
